CITY OF HAWAIIAN GARDENS  Wednesday, March 20, 2024
PLANNING COMMISSION MINUTES  Regular Meeting, 6:00 PM

Anna Rodriguez, Vice Chairmember  Fabiola Hernandez, Commissioner
Grant Winford, Commissioner  Luis Gonzalez, Commissioner

  Axzel Roman,
  Chairmember

  MINUTES
CALL TO ORDER

The Planning Commission meeting was called to order on Wednesday, March 20, 2024 at 6:00 PM.

FLAG SALUTE

The flag salute was led by Commissioner Gonzalez.

ROLL CALL
PRESENT
  Chairmember Winford
  Commissioner Hernandez
  Commissioner Gonzalez
  Commissioner Rodriguez
ABSENT
  1 Vice Chairmember Roman

PUBLIC COMMENTS ­ GENERAL OR ITEMS ON OR OFF THE AGENDA

Luis Alvarez spoke.

AGENDA ORGANIZATION
This is the time for the Planning Commission to discuss any changes in the order of agenda
items.

A.  PUBLIC HEARING(S) / HEARING(s)
1.  Recommendation to adopt Resolution No. 2024­001, approving a Conditional Use Permit No.
  2023­0070 and a determination of public convenience or necessity to permit an on­sale beer and
  wine license (Type 41) at an existing restaurant located at 12135 E. Carson Street, Hawaiian
  Gardens and determine the project is exempt pursuant to Section 15061(b)(3) of the California
  environmental quality act (CEQA).
  SUGGESTED ACTION: Approve Recommendation.

  Sophia Tatlyan, Senior Planner, presented staff report.

  Commissioner Winford spoke.

  Commissioner Hernandez spoke.

  NOES: 0
  ABSENT: 1 Roman

B.  CONSENT CALENDAR

1.  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Planning Commission meeting of Wednesday,
  December 13, 2023; and the Special Meeting of Thursday, December 21, 2023.

  SUGGESTED ACTION: Approve Recommendation.

  A motion was made by Chairmember Winford, seconded by Commissioner Rodriguez, to adopt
  Consent Calendar as presented, in its entirety.

  The motion was carried by the following vote:

  AYES: 4; Winford, Gonzalez, Hernandez, Rodriguez
  NOES: 0;
  ABSENT: 1; Roman
  RECUSE: 0;

  Motion carried: 4–0–1–0

C.  ORAL STAFF REPORT(S)

Elise McCaleb, Community Development Director, provided an update on the Housing Element, stating
that it was resubmitted to HCD, and that it will come back to the Planning Commission once it’s
approved.

D.  ADJOURNMENT

The Planning Commission meeting was adjourned at 6:41 PM
